title: 4x6 bird recipe cards
text: 4x6 bird recipe cards. These 4x6 recipe cards are just adorable.  The photo in the ad represents the card nicely.  They are a very nice thickness, sturdy.  They are ruled on BOTH sides.  I use these when someone asks for a recipe.  The arrived quickly ( I have prime) and in excellent condition with other items I ordered.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Meadowsweet Kitchens Recipe Card Set - 25 Double Sided Recipe Cards 4 x 6 Inch, Perfect Size Blank Cards for a Recipe Card Box, Make Your Own Personalized Recipe Book - Copper Brown
features: 4X6 RECIPE CARDS: This is the standard size of recipe cards to fit in a recipe box or recipe book. There's enough space on the front and back of the recipe card to include an ingredient list and every step of the recipe.
BEAUTIFUL DESIGN: These cards have an attractive Copper Brown design.

IDEAL SIZE: Our collection of recipe cards is the perfect fit for your recipe book binder or recipe tin. The cardstock is thick and the ink from your pen will not soak through. Our double sided recipe cards are great for long recipes.
MAKE YOUR OWN COOKBOOK: Create your own cookbook with our lovely recipe cards! It is perfect for curating a collection of family recipes for future generations.

FANTASTIC GIFT: Our set of recipe cards is an excellent mother's day gift or cooking gift for your mom, aunt, friends, and anyone else who loves to collect recipes. Please refer to the product grid for compatible items.
